result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **I'd recommend Stripe as the best overall payment processor**, with PayPal offered as an additional checkout option.

However, the best choice depends heavily on what platform your store uses and how much you're selling.

## Best payment processors for small online stores

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Standard US online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Great fraud prevention and reporting
- Excellent integrations with ecommerce platforms

Best for: New and growing online stores.

[Stripe pricing](https://stripe.com/pricing)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best for customer trust)

- Offers familiar PayPal checkout
- Supports eligible card and wallet payments
- Easy to integrate
- Can help customers feel comfortable purchasing

Best for: Offering customers another way to pay.

[PayPal business](https://www.paypal.com/us/business)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify
- Simplifies checkout and reporting
- No additional third-party transaction fee when using Shopify Payments
- Processing rates depend on your Shopify plan

Best for: Stores already running on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Combines online and in-person payments
- Inventory and sales management
- Easy setup

Best for: Businesses selling online and at physical locations.

[Square payments](https://squareup.com/us/en/payments)

[www.nerdwallet.com](https://www.nerdwallet.com/business/software/learn/stripe-vs-paypal-vs-square?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/blog/best-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/best-online-payment-solutions-for-businesses-2026-buyers-guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

If I were starting a small ecommerce business today\:

- **Stripe** for credit and debit card processing.
- **PayPal** as an additional checkout option.
- Shopify Payments instead of Stripe if the store is built on Shopify.

That gives customers flexibility without making your payment setup unnecessarily complicated.
